notes_zh:

data_description_en: Data for July 2011 to December 2014 and lists of registered low-income households and mid-low income households from 2015 to 2024.
notes_en: ※This database has been de-identified and direct identifying fields such as name and address have been deleted. If there are identification numbers such as national ID number, institution code, insured unit code, unified number, date of birth, medical visit date, admission date, etc., they have all been shielded, and the relevant data can only be used within a dedicated operational area set up by this department, and statistical results approved for release to ensure that the application and disclosure methods do not allow identification of specific individuals. Primary key with individual account and personal information matching value: ID.
